item.title: Memories Zero ~Aoi Hikari no Yakusoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Euphony Production
  • 発売日: 2001-11-09
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Memories Zero～蒼い光の約束～
  • 英語名: Memories Zero Aoi Hikari no Yakusoku

あらすじ

Tomo, Noa and Chikako are childhood friends who live in the same neighborhood.

They’ve been living a peaceful life where nothing much changes.

The midterm exams have ended, and the three of them are finally able to cut loose. They talk about going camping, enjoy school events, and while spending a fairly average time in school, Tomo begins to realize his feelings towards a certain girl…

  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はぁとでネットワーク
  • 英語名: Heart de Network

别名

  • I sent my heart for you.

あらすじ

Near future. Main character had to change schools often because of parents’ work, so he has few friends. Artificial intelligence program kept him company at that time. But then hero moves back to home town where he had childhood friends. This story beings in the season when wind begins to soften.

item.title: Kangatari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Euphony Production
  • 発売日: 2000-06-30
  • スコア: 6.15/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 神語 ～かんがたり～
  • 英語名: Kangatari

あらすじ

Main character is leading an ordinary school life. But then one day a student is found in the form of the living vegetable - organs are functioning normally, but there is no consciousness. Such living vegetables start to increase with each day. At the same time the unrivaled protagonists gets beaten by another boy who somehow acquired superficial powers. There’s some great conspiracy unwinding, and school administration seems to be involved.

  • 日本語名: 悲愛
  • 英語名: Hiai

あらすじ

Main character has been dating Yuka for a few years. But one day she just disappears and a few days later sends a letter. It contains compromising photos and confession that she does not want to live anymore. Hero swears to avenge the businessman mentioned in the letter and a few weeks later gets a job at that businessman’s mansion.

item.title: Happening Journey
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Euphony Production
  • 発売日: 1998-02-20
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はぷにんぐJOURNEY
  • 英語名: Happening Journey

别名

  • ハプニング・ジャーニー

あらすじ

Masaharu is long in love with his childhood friend Yuki, but lacks the courage to tell her his true feeling. One day Masaharu’s friend Takagi asks him to go on a ski trip together, telling him that he would also take Yuki for Masaharu, so that Masaharu would take Miki, his partner in their tennis club, for Takagi. Somehow their plan becomes known to other girls too, who start insisting on joining the trip - so the party now consists of seven boys and girls. Will Masaharu have a chance to tell Yuki his love during the trip?
